Чередование сторон сделано порядком в гриде, а не направлением флекса: на узкой ширине пары складываются в столбик, и обложка всегда остаётся над своим текстом. en.title: Adoption Numbers
en.description: A summary strip of metrics across all case studies on a warm accent backdrop, plus three mini-cards as proof. Self-contained: one file, no dependencies.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local --vibeui-case-006-* variables. A server component. On top sits the aggregate strip: a dl with three large numbers on a warm color-mix backdrop derived from the accent; on wide widths the numbers are separated by vertical rules. Below are three case mini-cards: client, task and metric — deliberately smaller than the strip, the hierarchy runs from the general to the particular. The large numbers are set in the accent colour with tabular-nums. Both grids fold based on the block's own width.

ai.summary: A summary of all adoptions: a strip with three large aggregate numbers on a warm accent backdrop and three mini-cards of specific cases below it. The aggregate answers "does this work at all", the cards answer "and for teams like yours". Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-case-006-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens (bg-card, border-border and the like)
the aggregate-over-particulars hierarchy: the strip is larger and warmer than the cards — the overall result first, the proof after
the strip's warm backdrop via color-mix from the accent — it highlights the aggregate without going to a solid fill
the dl semantics for the statistics: label — value pairs are a definition list
tabular-nums on the numbers: values do not jitter in width
the mini-cards deliberately smaller than the strip — equalising the type sizes kills the general-to-particular hierarchy
the vertical rules between numbers only on wide widths — a stacked column does not need them
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
adapt: eyebrow and title — the eyebrow and the section heading
the stats array — the strip's three aggregate numbers with captions
the items array — the client, task and metric of the three mini-cases
the accent through the accent prop — it colours the numbers, metrics and the strip backdrop
background — the component background; empty means no backdrop, taking the page colour
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
Both the stats and the cards are meant to come in threes: the wide grids are three-column, a fourth element wraps to a second row.
The aggregate numbers should sum across cases, not repeat a single one — otherwise the strip and the cards say the same thing.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the block has to stay a single file.
